newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Sea Tigers, the naval wing of the Tamil separatists (LTTE) lost six fighters and one craft when they intercepted the North Korea merchant ship Morang Bong last week, security sources said.
Moslems displaced from the northern Jaffna peninsula are willing to return to their former homes and resume a normal life as soon as possible, says M.C. Basheer, former deputy mayor of Jaffna.

The LTTE robbed everything including the food on the North Korean merchant ship Morang Bong and gave the crew only bread to eat, say crew members who were released and brought to Colombo. The LTTE captured the ship off the northern Point Pedro coast last week and killed one crew member in a shootout.
Health ministry to have flying squads to detect government doctors who do private practice during working hours, ministry sources say.
